name: sky_blue.md
text:
# Why Is the Sky Blue?

On a clear day the sky is a deep blue, but sunlight is white. So where does the blue come from?

## Sunlight is a mix

White sunlight is really a mix of every colour of the rainbow. Each colour is a wave, and blue light has a much shorter wave than red light.

## Scattering in the air

When sunlight hits the tiny molecules of gas in the air, short blue waves bounce around far more than long red waves. This is called Rayleigh scattering. Blue light ends up coming at us from every part of the sky.

## Red sunsets

At sunset the light travels through much more air. Most of the blue is scattered away before it reaches us, so the sky glows orange and red.
